posted_text:
🗓️ MI HB 5232 — Michigan Cities Could Now Pay Police & Firefighters During Military Leave

Michigan cities, villages, and counties could be required to offer paid leave to employees who serve in the military, under a new bill.

The measure would allow local governments to create a program to cover the difference between what an employee earns locally and what they receive from the military, if the local pay is higher.

This change would apply to employees of law enforcement agencies and fire departments, in addition to those taking military leave.

The bill’s passage hinges on the approval of Senate Bill No. ____ (S03649'25) and House Bill No. 5233 (H03649'25) of the 103rd Legislature.
